title: Fall of the Kandyan Kingdom
summary: Britain's war on the Kingdom of Kandy, proclaimed in January 1815, was over in forty days without notable military engagements. The king was captured and the Kandyan Convention ceded the kingdom to the British while keeping many of the chiefs' rights. After a rebellion in 1818, a British proclamation ended the Kandyan kingdom's earlier organization.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com treats the 1818 proclamation as concluding the integration of the kingdom into the British colonial sphere; 1815 is the year of the war, capture and Convention.
